title: Kona
desc: Narayana and his prophetic robot discover a remote village bound by an age-old sacrificial rite. Soon, he uncovers a sinister secret trapping the villagers in an endless cycle of past and present.

title: Zombie Kumar
desc: A video game developer and his companions travel to a village to attend their friend's wedding. However, their holiday turns into a nightmare due to a sudden zombie apocalypse.

title: Dana Kayonu
desc: A cowherd loves Jummi, the village beauty, as well as his loyal bull. However, his life changes when a multinational company offers him a huge fortune in exchange for his animal.

title: The Villain
desc: Ramu sets out to find his estranged brother, Rama, to reunite him with their mother. However, Ramu soon discovers that Rama is a mafia don, which makes it difficult for Ramu to approach his brother.

title: Preethse
desc: Surya, a military commander, is soon to be engaged to Kiran, a college student. Unbeknownst to him, one of Kiran's classmates is also in love with her.
